DM Sans and Manrope are self-hosted Google Fonts downloads, obtained 2026-11-24.
Both are distributed under the SIL Open Font License; see the accompanying license files.
The font files are unmodified. The original Unicode subsets and weight ranges are declared in index.html.
Only the two Latin subsets are preloaded. Additional subsets load when their characters are used.
Sources: https://fonts.google.com/specimen/DM+Sans and https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Manrope
